scope: 11 fire and 11 water formal active-skill source sheets
method: All 22 source sheets viewed individually with view_image. Qualitative silhouette, cell-boundary, background mass and frame-sequence inspection only; no player/runtime/commercial acceptance is claimed.
limitations: Static sheet inspection cannot prove temporal smoothness; animation must be reviewed on device.
Apparent colored rectangular fields are visual findings; exact per-pixel alpha should be checked before remediation.
No runtime QA result is inferred from source review.
